content: Home inspection AI competitors: Spectora AI Report Assist (voice observations + photos to report-ready comments matched to user style, claims 25% faster), InspectorData (AI categorizes photos and writes comments from 8,000+ pre-built lines, 30-day trial), NACHI community one-button 60-second report generation. These are template+comment-library AI writing aids, not deterministic engineering calculators with code citations.
